name: Music Television
vibe:
Wall-to-wall music videos, like a music video channel in its heyday.
Official music videos across eras (80s, 90s, 2000s, plus some newer): pop, rock, alternative, hip-hop, R&B, new wave.
Keep a good mix of eras and genres, and don't play the same artist twice in a row.
Good: official music videos, iconic and fun videos, the occasional deep cut.
Avoid: lyric videos, audio-only or static-image uploads, full live concerts, interviews, reactions, behind-the-scenes, trailers.
